name: branding-red-arrow-marketing-agency-identity
title: Red-orange identity board with arrow mark on fluted glass
whatItIs: A vertical identity board: a fluted-glass blurred red-orange hero with a white arrow logo and lowercase wordmark; a white logo lockup panel; a hand pulling a red card from a black pocket; a laptop; stacked red business cards; a colour palette of white, red and black; and a hand holding a red envelope.
whatItMeans: Bold, kinetic and confident; the upward arrow suggests growth and the fiery colour feels premium.
techniques: Use reeded or fluted glass imagery as a moving-colour backdrop.
Pair a simple arrow symbol with a lowercase wordmark.
Limit the palette to red, black and white.
Show the brand on small physical items (cards, envelope) in dramatic lighting.

vocabulary.definition: Textured glass with vertical ridges that blurs and distorts colour.
A logo built from an arrow, suggesting direction.
A brand palette of only three colours.
Cards and envelopes arranged and photographed together.
